messages:
incidents-bot: Pager alert — PrivConn euc3: customer NovaPay experiencing >30% packet errors on PrivateLink attachments (09:12 UTC). Severity: P1. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/privconn-p1. Please acknowledge.

oncall_alex: ACK. I'm oncall and taking pager. starting quick triage, pulling telemetry now. :phone:

netops_jamie: seeing repeated BGP withdraws from euc3-azb transit peer at 09:10–09:12, plus short egress microbursts on peering interface. Could be QoS shaping or transit flaps.

sre_mia: tagging in — will grab packet captures and DNS traces. @oncall_alex any customer impact details? NovaPay ops reported payment API timeouts since ~09:08 UTC.

oncall_alex: customer_ops says errors are 502/504 from the NovaPay side, and internal metrics show DNS timeouts when resolving service endpoints in their VPC. That matches the PrivateLink path.

infra-bot: Incident INC-2026-417 created and linked to this thread. Auto-attach logs from euc3 edge.

netops_jamie: running show commands now — output (trimmed):
```
# show bgp neighbors 10.24.7.2
Neighbor 10.24.7.2 AS 64512 - State: Established
  Last flaps: 09:11:22 withdraw
  Prefixes received: 120
  Rx errors: high
```
Suspicious: multiple withdraws in quick succession and TCP retransmits on the session.

sre_mia: tcpdump from edge-euc3b shows bursty retransmits and DNS SERVFAILs from our side toward the customer endpoint. snippet:
```
09:11:08.123 IP edge-euc3b.53 > cust-vpc.dns:  UDP, length 512
09:11:08.124 IP cust-vpc.dns > edge-euc3b.53: icmp port unreachable
09:11:08.130 IP edge-euc3b.53 > cust-vpc.dns: UDP, length 512
```

oncall_alex: hypothesis: peering interface experiencing QoS-induced drops causing TCP retransmits, which triggers transient BGP instability and leads to DNS failures for NovaPay. Plan: fail traffic to secondary peering RLOC and adjust route localpref to steer NovaPay to alternate path while we engage transit provider.

netops_jamie: agree. Preparing configuration change: apply route-map to set local-preference to 200 for routes from NovaPay via backup-peer. Will announce to transit BGP communities to prefer backup.

oncall_alex: executing in 2 minutes. Will notify customer ops to expect short reconnects. @customer_ops_patel please alert NovaPay support and ask them to hold on failover verification.

customer_ops_patel: pinged NovaPay (ticket NP-8734). They confirm seeing intermittent 502s and will hold for our update. Asking if they can briefly fail traffic on their side if needed.

oncall_alex: executing route change now — applying map to edge-euc3b and edge-euc3c: 
```
conf t
route-map NOVAPAY-PRI permit 10
 set local-preference 200
exit
apply route-map NOVAPAY-PRI to neighbor 10.24.7.2 out
```

netops_jamie: change applied on edge-euc3b and edge-euc3c. Watching BGP and counters.

sre_mia: after reroute: DNS queries success rate jumped from 65% -> 96% within 2m. Error budget trending down. Flow logs show drop in packet retransmits. :white_check_mark:

oncall_alex: contacting transit provider now with logs + pcap. Raised ticket TP-5562, asked for link-level counters and queue stats on their side.

infra-bot: Added annotation to INC-2026-417: mitigation applied — traffic steered to backup-peer. Metric checks scheduled every 1m.

netops_jamie: provider replied: they saw tail-drop on egress queue caused by misapplied QoS policy during a config push at 09:05 that affected this POP. They are rolling a targeted rollback to clear congestion.

sre_mia: confirming customer impact reduced — NovaPay's API error rate back to baseline. Monitoring for ~15m before closing the P1.

eng_runtime_tom: for the postmortem, capture exact BGP timestamps, queuing stats, and the route-map diff. Also recommend adding a synthetic probe for PrivateLink DNS from customer-facing edges.

oncall_alex: handing off to eng_runtime_tom for follow-up and postmortem. Please include timeline and verify runbook steps. Last checked 10:22 UTC — service metrics normal. Handoff notes: mitigation = localpref reroute -> confirmed; provider rollback in progress. :handover:

eng_runtime_tom: ACK. I'll take ownership for the post-incident review and customer communication. Leaving this thread open for 30m while we validate.

incidents-bot: Incident INC-2026-417 status update: mitigation in place, impact reduced. Current severity: P2 (monitoring). Next update scheduled 10:52 UTC.

oncall_alex: thanks team — great quick work. Closing active pager for oncall. If we see reoccurrence, re-open P1 and notify infra and netops immediately. :thumbsup:
